what: Shape census of the advisory tier — the 'grow proven / shrink advisory' ceiling. Each of the 76 zod advisory facts is classified by WHAT KIND of claim it is: provable NOW by an existing sound shape, provable by a plausible NEW structural sound shape, or irreducibly semantic. Answers: how much can the advisory tier shrink, and where does the next sound-shape investment pay off?
method: single Sonnet classifier over the 76 claim TEXTS against a fixed rubric (the 4 existing sound shapes: depends-on / count / negation / transition). An ESTIMATE, not a law — one repo (zod), one LLM pass judging claim shape, not the source.
shrink_ceiling: ~29% (22/76) of the advisory tier is structural and could move to a 0-false proven arm IF new sound shapes were built; ~71% (54/76) is irreducibly semantic — claims about zod's OWN runtime behavior (parse accepts/rejects/throws/coerces) that no mechanical oracle can decide from one unit's bytes.
highest_leverage_new_shape: The TEST-VACUITY family is ~9 of the 21 NEW_SHAPE claims: no-assertion-in-test (3), assertion-only-in-catch (2), unasserted-parse-call (2), commented-out-tests (2). A single AST oracle 'a test body has an assertion on every non-exceptional path' would convert the largest structural cluster to proven.
why_advisory_is_the_residue: dependency and count claims are ~0 in the advisory slot because those SHAPES already route to the proven arm (separate mine slots: advisory vs dependency vs count). So advisory is BY DESIGN the semantic residue, and its 86.8% precision is measured on the genuinely-hard claims. 'Shrink advisory' is therefore NOT reclassification — it is building new sound shapes (as the transition shape #234 already did once).
connection_to_the_hallucinations: One of the two mechanically-verified cross-repo FALSEs (dd7f1aede, 'a test that does not exist / assertion only in catch') falls in the test-vacuity NEW_SHAPE family — the same structural family that would most grow the proven arm is also where genesis most confabulates on test files. (The other FALSE, ffc0cbfe, is SEMANTIC runtime behavior.)
